invariants.rationale: The method returns a non-null Option; Option type should not be null in a properly implemented Java method.
The rollback instant time should be a valid non-null string to construct the rollback executor.
A valid HoodieInstant to rollback is required to execute the rollback plan.
The HoodieEngineContext is required to execute actions on the table.
If the Option is present, its value should be of the expected type HoodieRollbackPlan.
